messages:
nora_sales: Acme says their PoC hit a wall during CI runs — mix of 401s and 403s. Can someone swarm?
acme_dev: Our dev laptop calls succeed but CI returns 401 Invalid API key. When we flip projects we occasionally get 403 Forbidden. We used the onboarding token.
dev_ash: OK quick checks: 1) Authorization header present? 2) Any RWD_* envs in CI? 3) x-rwd-request-id from failing response?
acme_dev: Header is `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>` (we'll paste exact token id if needed). Fail response included `x-rwd-request-id: rwd-req-f2c9b`.
mike_infra: Pulling request rwd-req-f2c9b from logs...
secrets_bot: secrets-service: lookup rwd-req-f2c9b -> key fingerprint found, status: active, bound_org: org-acme-poc, bound_project: poc-web, scopes: [inference:generate], last_rotation: 2026-02-15T08:12:00Z.
acme_dev: We do have RWD_PROJECT=legacy-test in our CI env (leftover). We didn't realize SDK attaches that.
dev_ash: That explains 403 when project header mismatches. 401 could be stale/rotated key on one runner. Are all runners using same secret?
acme_dev: One runner had a different secret id; ops said they rotated a token earlier.
ops_bot: ops: audit -> runner-3 used key rwd-old_45 which was rotated at 2026-02-16T01:05:22Z -> status: disabled.
nora_sales: Immediate unblock path?
dev_ash: Two options: A) remove RWD_PROJECT from CI and redeploy, B) generate a short-lived CI key bound to the project the runners use. For demo speed I'll create a scoped key.
secrets_bot: secrets-service: created key `rwd-test_acme_ci_42`, bound_org: org-acme-poc, bound_project: poc-web, scopes: [inference:generate], expires: 72h, status: active. id: rwd-test_acme_ci_42.
acme_dev: Deployed new key -> CI now returns 200. Thanks.
mike_infra: Couple of follow-ups: 1) proxy/CI runners can inject `X-RWD-Org-Id` — check for that; 2) suggest rotating keys on CI every 48-72h; 3) for hosted PoC we cannot do per-key IP allowlist, that is only on Dedicated/Private.
acme_dev: Security asked if we can have embeddings-only keys and service-account keys for CI.
dev_ash: Yes hosted PoCs support scope-limited keys (embeddings-only, inference-only) and short TTL. Service-account style keys exist but IP CIDR restrict requires Dedicated/Private.
nora_sales: They also saw intermittent 429s when running parallel embedding jobs. Any recommended default?
mike_infra: For PoCs start at 40-60 req/min per client, batch embeddings into 8-16 items, use exponential backoff with full jitter on 429s, monitor `x-rwd-remaining` and `x-rwd-reset` headers. If you need higher throughput, request a temporary quota bump via your SDR.
acme_dev: Minor UX ask: would be great if console showed "bound org/project" and last rotation next to keys. We wasted time digging logs.
dev_ash: Agreed. I'll file a small ticket to surface key binding and rotation timestamp.
ops_bot: crm: PoC ACME-POC-214 updated -> attached key rwd-test_acme_ci_42, notes: env leak RWD_PROJECT removed, stale rotated key found, rate guidance attached.
nora_sales: Closing swarm — please ping if any auth issues recur. :white_check_mark:
